notes.title: The demo version is released
notes.notes:
Hello,
The demo version of “Natsuno-kanata: Beyond summer” was released today.
The demo version, which is compatible with Windows and Mac, allows users to play the first part of the “Alta” and “Lira” episodes, which are newly added to the main game, as well as the first part of the game. The full game is scheduled for release on June 20. We hope you will give “Natsuno-kanata: Beyond summer” your full attention!
